title: 2nd Sitting of 1st Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/2/1/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 58/2024 to 60/2024).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission, under Constitution Article 116(a), of changes to the mandates of three of the ministries created on 17 November 2023 is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission on the measures decided for the next two years to cut state expenditure under the economic reform agenda is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission to appoint the President and Vice President of the Elections Commission (Elections Commission Act, Law No. 8/2008, Article 7(b)) is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission to appoint the Vice President of the Anti-Corruption Commission (Anti-Corruption Commission Act, Law No. 13/2008, Article 7(b)) is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request for Parliament's consent, under Constitution Article 129, for Thoriq Ibrahim (G. Noomaraahiya), appointed Minister of Tourism and Environment on 1 February 2025, is sent to the relevant standing committee.
First reading of the Bill amending the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Machchangoalhi Central MP Ahmed Zameer.

Preliminary debate on a resolution by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir calling on the government to remove barriers that resort and hotel grooming and dress codes place on staff wearing the hijab or keeping a neat beard and moustache, and to set a general grooming and dress standard for tourism workers.
Preliminary debate on the Bill on Prevention of Gang Crimes and Other Serious Crimes, submitted on behalf of the government by Machchangoalhi South MP Mustafa Hussain.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The first working sitting of 2025 was scheduled to send five presidential submissions (ministry mandates, spending cuts, EC and ACC appointments, a new minister) to committees, introduce the Decentralisation Act amendment, and debate a resort dress-code resolution and the gang crimes bill.
